notes.title: TOTAL FACTORY is here
notes.content:
Total Factory

https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=IsC0YNbJxLY
Get Total Factory now!

You are a robot with unrealistically advanced artificial intelligence on a previously unknown planet, people created you for one single purpose - to ensure the automatic production of the necessary resources and their dispatch. It would seem that what could go wrong?

You start the game from your base, your creators - the CosmoDoc corporation - gave you the starting amount of the necessary resources and a couple of robots to protect your base from enemies.

Complete tasks from the task center to unlock new machines for automation and advance further in the game.
In the game, you can not only automate your factory, but also ensure its protection with the help of automatic turrets and allied robots.

Game Features:

 Quite a large procedurally generated world.
 4 different biomes: Tundra, Meadow, Desert and Jungle.
 More than 100 different game items.
 Mining.
 Growing and caring for vegetables and fruits grown from seeds.
 Protection of your factory from enemy units ready to destroy everything in their path.
 6 types of mined ore: Iron, Aluminum, Copper, Gold, Coal, Quartz.
 Supply electricity to automated machines with solid fuel generators, the game has a whole power grid system, don't forget to take the wires.
 There are many machines in the game to automate the process, ranging from the simplest conveyor belt to an assembly machine.
 Isometric with nice 2D graphics.
 Nice music.


The game is still in development, many opportunities are still ahead.

notes.title: Hello Friends and Happy New Year!
notes.content:
Welcome Friends!

ː2015hollyːOur team wishes everyone a Happy New Year and wishes to achieve your goals in the New Year and close people to be always with you.ː2015hollyː

We have a gift for you. We have prepared a grand update that we have been creating for you for several months. We meticulously approached changes and improvements that will bring diversity to the gameplay.

Below you will find the entire list of changes in the game:
[olist]
The inventory has been added.
A crafting window has been added in the inventory.
A panel for quick access to items has been added.
Changed the battle system. You can fight with Death.
The main character has been received a supply of health. You will not die immediately when confronted with Death.
The main character has been received a supply of satiety. With zero satiety, the hero’s health points will be taken away.
Enemies also have been reserved their own health, so it will not easy to kill them.
You can restore the health of the main character with bottles for restoring HP.
The resource panel has been removed.
The icon flying to the corner of the screen after collecting resources has been removed.
All the main character’s sprites have been redone, new animations have been add and existing ones have been modified.
Land has been improved, now it is smoother.
You can create tools for resource extraction. Each of them has its own strength.
Several types of spears have been added, all of them differ in damage characteristics, strength and appearance.
Things that did not fit into the inventory will lie on the ground, even after loading from saved.
We added several options for food that can be obtained by mining other resources.
A new resource has benn added in the game - gold, it drops out with a small chance when mining other resources.
The trader’s shop has been changed, now instead of updating tools, you open new toolsand and buy recipes to create a tool. Hammer has been added.
The ability has been added to drop items from enemies after their death. Main subject is the “Soul of Machines", with a rather small chance of a HP Bottle, with a small chance of Chip deaving, with a lower chance of a Crystal, with a very low chance of any Spear, or with an incredibly small chance of Gold.
The Spear may fall out of the drawer both in random game and in custom game.
Tool strength have been rebalanced.
All objects have been received a level of health instead of the number of strokes, tools received a level of damage.
[/olist]

Important! Unfortunately, after updating the game, previous save games will not work! We regret it, however, this is a necessary step to make the game more interesting.

Have a nice weekend and enjoy the best moments of the game!

notes.title: The game is available!
notes.content:
Hello everyone!

The game came out that we with all our hearts created for more than a year! Deadly Step is a 2D game in a mixed genre of real time and turn-based adventure game with elements of horror, sandbox and top view.

You are waiting for the story, trophies and items that their story will immerse into the world of games. Each of the 20 levels is unique and you need to go through them all to get one of the 2 story endings. When passing, you will meet a merchant who will improve skills for natural resources, 3 types of traps, chests with resources and trophies and many Deaths who will lie in wait at every step and try to kill you.

And you can create up to 20 of your own levels and share them with other players and play levels on the time.

We are pleased to share the game with you, and it will be doubly nice if it fits your soul the way we liked.
